name: Seikan Megami Senki Metal Doll
original_name: 星間女神戦記 METAL DOLL
source:
Confrontation between the Tauros faction and the Leo faction becomes extremely fierce after a  mysterious explosion of the huge mother ship. Main character is sent from the Earth to investigate the situation. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
巨大母舰发生神秘爆炸后，金牛座阵营与狮子座阵营的冲突变得异常激烈。主角从地球被派去调查情况。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
